deleted_row.tasting_notes:

Palate: Unbelievably deep and viscous. It opens with luxurious layers of dark chocolate, Christmas cake, espresso beans, and warm rancio, balanced by the classic Glenrothes bright, velvety fruit structure.
Finish: Immense and everlasting. The finish is beautifully dry and warming, dominated by deep wood spices, nutmeg, leather, and a faint hint of sweet tobacco.
